title: Uniform linear approximation for the absolute Rademacher sum
statement:
There exists a constant $C>0$ such that, for every natural number $n$, every $a_1,\dots,a_n\in\mathbb R$ with $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$, and every $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$ satisfying $|a_i|\le\varepsilon$ for all $i$, independent uniform signs $X_1,\dots,X_n\in\{-1,1\}$ satisfy
\[
\left|\mathbb E\left|\sum_{i=1}^n a_iX_i\right|-\sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}}\right|\le C\varepsilon.
\]
hypotheses_covered: there exists a positive real constant C
real coefficients a_i with sum of squares 1
